sentences.text_target: Arthur was a daily commuter who rarely explored beyond his usual routine.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːrθər wɒz ə ˈdeɪli kəˈmjuːtər huː ˈreərli ɪkˈsplɔːrd bɪˈjɒnd hɪz ˈjuːʒuəl ruːˈtiːn/
sentences.text_native: Arthur était un navetteur quotidien qui explorait rarement au-delà de sa routine habituelle.

sentences.text_target: On this particular morning, he decided to exit the underground system at an unfamiliar platform.
sentences.phonetic: /ɒn ðɪs pərˈtɪkjələr ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, hiː dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː ˈɛɡzɪt ði ˈʌndərɡraʊnd ˈsɪstəm ət ən ʌnˈfəmɪliər ˈplætfɔːrm/
sentences.text_native: Ce matin-là, il décida de sortir du réseau souterrain à une station inhabituelle.

sentences.text_target: He stepped out onto the crowded pavement and immediately realized he had miscalculated his trajectory.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː stɛpt aʊt ˈɒntuː ðə ˈkraʊdɪd ˈpeɪvmənt ənd ɪˈmiːdiətli ˈriːəlaɪzd hiː hæd ˌmɪsˈkælkjuleɪtɪd hɪz trəˈdʒɛktəri/
sentences.text_native: Il mit le pied sur le trottoir bondé et réalisa immédiatement qu'il avait mal calculé sa trajectoire.

sentences.text_target: The morning breeze was chilly, and his heavy leather shoes echoed against the stone steps.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ briːz wɒz ˈʧɪli, ənd hɪz ˈhɛvi ˈlɛðər ʃuːz ˈɛkəʊd əˈɡɛnst ðə stəʊn stɛps/
sentences.text_native: La brise matinale était fraîche, et ses lourdes chaussures en cuir résonnaient contre les marches en pierre.

sentences.text_target: Instead of turning left toward the bustling avenue, he hesitated at the corner.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪnˈstɛd əv ˈtɜːrnɪŋ lɛft təˈwɔːrd ðə ˈbʌslɪŋ ˈævənuː, hiː ˈhɛzɪteɪtɪd ət ðə ˈkɔːrnər/
sentences.text_native: Au lieu de tourner à gauche vers l'avenue animée, il hésita au coin de la rue.

sentences.text_target: A puzzled expression appeared on his face as he reached into his pocket for his smartphone.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈpʌzəld ɪkˈsprɛʃən əˈpɪərd ɒn hɪz feɪs æz hiː riːtʃt ˈɪntuː hɪz ˈpɒkɪt fɔːr hɪz ˈsmɑːrtfəʊn/
sentences.text_native: Une expression perplexe apparut sur son visage alors qu'il fouillait dans sa poche pour attraper son smartphone.

sentences.text_target: To his absolute horror, the battery was completely dead.
sentences.phonetic: /tuː hɪz ˈæbsəluːt ˈhɒrər, ðə ˈbætəri wɒz kəmˈpliːtli dɛd/
sentences.text_native: À son grand désespoir, la batterie était complètement déchargée.

sentences.text_target: Without a map or schedule, he felt entirely lost within the dense urban labyrinth.
sentences.phonetic: /wɪðˈaʊt ə mæp ɔːr ˈʃɛduːl, hiː fɛlt ɪnˈtaɪəri lɒst wɪˈðɪn ðə dɛns ˈɜːrbən ˈlæbərɪnθ/
sentences.text_native: Sans carte ni horaire, il se sentait totalement perdu au sein de ce labyrinthe urbain dense.

sentences.text_target: He needed to ask someone for help before he became seriously late for his appointment.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈniːdɪd tuː ɑːsk ˈsʌmwʌn fɔːr hɛlp bɪˈfɔːr hiː bɪˈkeɪm ˈsɪriəsli leɪt fɔːr hɪz əˈpɔɪntmənt/
sentences.text_native: Il devait demander de l'aide à quelqu'un avant d'être sérieusement en retard pour son rendez-vous.

sentences.text_target: Spotting a friendly pedestrian approaching from the bakery, Arthur decided to step forward.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈspɒtɪŋ ə ˈfrɛndli pəˈdɛstriən əˈprəʊtʃɪŋ frəm ðə ˈbeɪkəri, ˈɑːrθər dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː stɛp ˈfɔːrwərd/
sentences.text_native: Apercevant un piéton sympathique qui s'approchait de la boulangerie, Arthur décida de faire un pas en avant.

sentences.text_target: A warm smell of fresh bread drifted from the shop, reminding him that he was also hungry.
sentences.phonetic: /ə wɔːrm smɛl əv frɛʃ brɛd ˈdrɪftɪd frəm ðə ʃɒp, rɪˈmaɪndɪŋ hɪm ðæt hiː wɒz ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈhʌŋɡri/
sentences.text_native: Une douce odeur de pain frais s'échappait de la boutique, lui rappelant qu'il avait aussi faim.

sentences.text_target: He cleared his throat politely and smiled at the stranger.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː klɪərd hɪz θroʊt pəˈlaɪtli ənd smaɪld ət ðə ˈstreɪndʒər/
sentences.text_native: Il se racla la gorge poliment et sourit à l'inconnu.

sentences.text_target: Excuse me, sir, could you please help me find my way around this unfamiliar district?
sentences.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz miː, sɜːr, kʊd juː pliːz hɛlp miː faɪnd maɪ weɪ əˈraʊnd ðɪs ʌnˈfəmɪliər ˈdɪstrɪkt/
sentences.text_native: Excusez-moi, monsieur, pourriez-vous m'aider à me repérer dans ce quartier inconnu ?

sentences.text_target: The man stopped walking, adjusted his jacket, and looked down at Arthur with an understanding grin.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə mæn stɒpt ˈwɔːkɪŋ, əˈdʒʌstɪd hɪz ˈdʒækɪt, ənd lʊkt daʊn ət ˈɑːrθər wɪð ən ˌʌndərˈstændɪŋ ɡrɪn/
sentences.text_native: L'homme s'arrêta de marcher, rajusta sa veste et regarda Arthur avec un sourire compréhensif.

sentences.text_target: Of course, replied the local resident, this neighborhood can be quite complicated to navigate.
sentences.phonetic: /ɒv kɔːrs, rɪˈplaɪd ðə ˈləʊkəl ˈrɛzɪdənt, ðɪs ˈneɪbərhʊd kən biː kwaɪt ˈkɒmplɪkeɪtɪd tuː ˈnævɪɡeɪt/
sentences.text_native: Bien sûr, répondit le résident local, ce quartier peut s'avérer assez compliqué à parcourir.

sentences.text_target: Where exactly are you trying to go today?
sentences.phonetic: /wɛr ɪɡˈzæklti ɑːr juː ˈtraɪɪŋ tuː ɡəʊ təˈdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Où essayez-vous exactement d'aller aujourd'hui ?

sentences.text_target: Arthur pulled out a small notebook and a pen from his coat pocket.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːrθər pʊld aʊt ə smɔːl ˈnʊtbʊk ənd ə pɛn frəm hɪz kəʊt ˈpɒkɪt/
sentences.text_native: Arthur sortit un petit carnet et un stylo de la poche de son manteau.

sentences.text_target: I need to reach the main corporate building near the central park.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tuː riːtʃ ðə meɪn ˈkɔːrpərət ˈbɪldɪŋ nɪr ðə ˈsɛntrəl pɑːrk/
sentences.text_native: Je dois rejoindre le bâtiment d'entreprise principal près du parc central.

sentences.text_target: Ah, that is a prominent skyscraper with a huge glass façade that reflects the sunlight.
sentences.phonetic: /ɑː, ðæt ɪz ə ˈprɒmɪnənt ˈskaɪˌskreɪpər wɪð ə hjuːdʒ glæs fəˈsɑːd ðæt rɪˈflɛkts ðə ˈsʌnlaɪt/
sentences.text_native: Ah, c'est un gratte-ciel remarquable doté d'une immense façade en verre qui reflète la lumière du soleil.

sentences.text_target: It is conveniently situated just two blocks away from the police station.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz kənˈviːniəntli ˈsɪtʃueɪtɪd dʒʌst tuː blɒks əˈweɪ frəm ðə pəˈliːs ˈsteɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: Il est idéalement situé à seulement deux pâtés de maisons du poste de police.

sentences.text_target: You need to proceed straight down this narrow street until you reach the traffic lights.
sentences.phonetic: /juː niːd tuː prəˈsiːd streɪt daʊn ðɪs ˈnɛroʊ striːt ənˈtɪl juː riːtʃ ðə ˈtræfɪk laɪts/
sentences.text_native: Vous devez continuer tout droit dans cette rue étroite jusqu'à ce que vous arriviez aux feux de circulation.

sentences.text_target: Then, cross the pedestrian crossing carefully past the old hospital.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn, krɒs ðə pəˈdɛstriən ˈkrɒsɪŋ ˈkɛrfʊli pɑːst ði əʊld ˈhɒspɪtəl/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, traversez le passage piéton avec précaution en passant devant le vieux hôpital.

sentences.text_target: After passing the bank on your right, turn immediately down the dark alleyway.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈæftər ˈpɑːsɪŋ ðə bæŋk ɒn jʊr raɪt, tɜːrn ɪˈmiːdiətli daʊn ðə dɑːrk ˈæliˌweɪ/
sentences.text_native: Après avoir dépassé la banque sur votre droite, engagez-vous immédiatement dans la sombres ruelle.

sentences.text_target: Do not worry about missing the junction because there is clear signage everywhere.
sentences.phonetic: /duː nɒt ˈwʌri əˈbaʊt ˈmɪsɪŋ ðə ˈdʒʌŋkʃən bɪˈkɒz ðɛr ɪz klɪər ˈsaɪnɪdʒ ˈɛvriˌwɛr/
sentences.text_native: Ne vous inquiétez pas de rater l'intersection car il y a une signalisation claire partout.

sentences.text_target: Arthur listened carefully while noting down every single landmark in his notebook.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːrθər ˈlɪsənd ˈkɛrfʊli waɪl ˈnəʊtɪŋ daʊn ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈlændˌmɑːrk ɪn hɪz ˈnʊtbʊk/
sentences.text_native: Arthur écouta attentivement tout en notant chaque point de repère dans son carnet.

sentences.text_target: He thanked the helpful stranger for taking the time to explain the route.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː θæŋkt ðə ˈhɛlpfʊl ˈstreɪndʒər fɔːr ˈteɪkɪŋ ðə taɪm tuː ɪkˈspleɪn ðə ruːt/
sentences.text_native: Il remercia l'inconnu serviable d'avoir pris le temps de lui expliquer l'itinéraire.

sentences.text_target: Walking briskly along the sidewalk, he finally spotted the prominent glass structure.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈwɔːkɪŋ ˈbrɪskli əˈlɒŋ ðə ˈsaɪdˌwɔːk, hiː ˈfaɪnəli ˈspɒtɪd ðə ˈprɒmɪnənt glæs ˈstrʌktʃər/
sentences.text_native: Marchant d'un pas vif le long du trottoir, il aperçut enfin la structure en verre remarquable.

sentences.text_target: His goal was now within reach, and his worries began to fade away.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ɡəʊl wɒz naʊ wɪˈðɪn riːtʃ, ənd hɪz ˈwʌriz bɪˈɡæn tuː feɪd əˈweɪ/
sentences.text_native: Son objectif était désormais à portée de main, et ses inquiétudes commencèrent à s'estomper.

sentences.text_target: He pushed open the heavy glass door just a few minutes before his meeting started.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː pʊʃt ˈəʊpən ðə ˈhɛvi glæs dɔːr dʒʌst ə fjuː ˈmɪnɪts bɪˈfɔːr hɪz ˈmiːtɪŋ ˈstɑːrtɪd/
sentences.text_native: Il poussa la lourde porte en verre juste quelques minutes avant que sa réunion ne commence.

sentences.text_target: Successfully arriving on time proved that asking for directions is a valuable daily skill.
sentences.phonetic: /səkˈsɛsfʊli əˈraɪvɪŋ ɒn taɪm pruːvd ðæt ˈɑːskɪŋ fɔːr dəˈrɛkʃənz ɪz ə ˈvæljuəbəl ˈdeɪli skɪl/
sentences.text_native: Arriver à l'heure avec succès a prouvé que demander son chemin est une compétence quotidienne précieuse.
